title: Concept: Maven build plugin without a pinned version
description: pom.xml declares a build plugin that declares no version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Maven resolves the plugin to its latest release, so code that runs during the build changes without any change to the pom.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: Maven resolves the plugin to its latest release, so code that runs during the build changes without any change to the pom.
